# eyaml_decrypt (Ephemeral Resource)

This ephemeral resource decrypts data using the given private and public key, without storing the result in the plan or state. This is similar to `eyaml decrypt` command line.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "eyaml_decrypt" "db_password" {
  private_key = file("${path.module}/keys/private_key.pkcs7.pem")
  public_key  = file("${path.module}/keys/public_key.pkcs7.pem")
  data        = yamldecode(file("${path.module}/common.eyaml"))["db_password"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) Data to decrypt.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key used for decryption.
- `public_key` (String) Public key used for decryption.

### Read-Only

- `decrypted_data` (String, Sensitive) Decrypted data.
